tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and roll-log ground. Dark is the hero theme; the app follows the OS.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Toolbar, sidebar, formula box, popovers, status bar. Separated from bg by a line, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered preset rows, pressed controls, the active filter chip.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: The expanded die tree under a roll.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between roll entries, panes and table rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines and kbd borders (3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and roll totals.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Formulas, kept dice, secondary UI text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, labels (# text), dropped dice, kbd hints. 6.3:1 on dark bg, 5.8:1 on light.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The lime, a FILL: input cursor, focus ring on dark, selected-entry edge, the natural-20 chip, the one primary button in a dialog. Rare by design.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill (14:1).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal as TEXT: the formula prompt, @variables, success ✓, focus ring on light.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Selected roll entry and the highlighted autocomplete row.

tokens.name: wip
tokens.usage: ~ a replaced preset and warnings. Always paired with the ~ sign.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: ✗ failure dice, the natural-1 outline, formula errors and carets, − deleted. Always paired with a glyph.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind an error entry.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.usage: Roll labels, help text, menu descriptions.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: A roll's total: right-aligned, tabular numbers. The hero of every row.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Formulas, dice breakdowns, variables, the die tree.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps, entry headers, status bar, kbd, section labels (uppercase, +0.06em).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps in toolbars and the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between roll-row columns; compact side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Roll-log side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Rare: large empty states.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Roll entries, die chips, highlights.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Controls, kbd, chips, menu rows, the die tree.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Panels, popovers, the formula box, command palette.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, preset and menu rows.

tokens.name: size-roll-row
tokens.usage: One roll in the log (30px compact).

tokens.name: size-input
tokens.usage: The formula box (36px compact).

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Top bar; left inset 84px for macOS window buttons (macOS only).

tokens.name: size-status
tokens.usage: Status bar.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Character rail; becomes a slide-over below 960px window width.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icons, 1.5 stroke (14px inside 24px controls).

tokens.name: size-window-min
tokens.usage: Minimum window width (height 480px).

tokens.name: size-window-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum window height.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Entrance transitions (popovers, new roll entries); 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.
